title: Rain, Rain, Go Away - A Sunny Sing-Along Song for Toddlers
description: Wave the rain goodbye and jump out into the sunshine! Sing along with us. #kidssong #nurseryrhyme #toddlersongs #singalong #weathersong
characters: Three adorable Black toddlers: Zuri, a 3-year-old girl with deep warm brown skin, round afro puffs tied with soft yellow fabric scrunchies, wearing a sunny yellow t-shirt, denim dungaree shorts and white sneakers; Kofi, a 4-year-old boy with medium-deep brown skin, short dark natural curly hair, wearing a blue t-shirt, grey jogger shorts and red sneakers; and Nala, a 3-year-old girl with deep brown skin, neat cornrow braids, wearing a yellow pinafore dress over a white t-shirt, white tights and pink sneakers

verses.scene: The three toddlers press their noses to a big window, watching fat cartoon raindrops run down the glass.
The toddlers wave up at a small grey cloud from a doorway, boots on, ready to go outside.

lines: Clap your hands and sing with me
Rain, rain, go, one, two, three
verses.scene: The toddlers clap their hands together on a covered porch, counting on their fingers as the rain eases.

lines: We will jump and dance today
verses.scene: Bright sunshine breaks through as the toddlers jump and dance in the wet grass under a big rainbow.

pd_source.author: Traditional (English)
pd_source.publication: Recorded by James Howell in Paroimiographia / Proverbs (London, 1659-1687) as 'Raine raine goe away, come againe a Saterday'; the modern wording is standard in 19th-century nursery collections.
pd_source.public_domain: Anonymous traditional text recorded in the 17th century; long out of copyright everywhere.
pd_source.adaptation: Verses 1 and 2 are the standard traditional couplets verbatim. Verse 3 and the hook are NEWLY WRITTEN in the same meter.

song_style: children's nursery rhyme, cheerful upbeat kids song, cute female child voice, simple very repetitive catchy melody, gentle bouncy tempo, playful, bright, warm
